## Setup

Adjust `input_path` below to point at your combined RM annotation CSV.

```{r}
#| label: setup
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(stringr)
library(vegan)
library(ape)
library(ggplot2)
```

```{r}
#| label: load-data
input_path <- "~/Objective_3/Objective_3_motifs_analysis/data/all_motifs_concat.tsv"

df <- read.delim(input_path, sep = "\t", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Drop rows with no motif called
df <- df %>% filter(Motif != "No Motif Assigned")

n_isolates <- n_distinct(df$sample)
n_isolates

```

```{r}
#| label: exact-match
motif_isolate_counts <- df %>%
  distinct(sample, Motif) %>%
  count(Motif, name = "n_isolates") %>%
  arrange(desc(n_isolates))

common_exact <- motif_isolate_counts %>%
  filter(n_isolates == n_distinct(df$sample))

cat("Motifs present in every isolate (exact match):\n")
print(common_exact)
```

```{r}
#| label: exact-match-freq
cat("Motif frequency across isolates (top 20, exact match):\n")
print(head(motif_isolate_counts, 20))
```

```{r}
#| label: iupac-functions
iupac_comp <- c(A = "T", T = "A", C = "G", G = "C", N = "N",
                 R = "Y", Y = "R", S = "S", W = "W", K = "M", M = "K",
                 B = "V", V = "B", D = "H", H = "D")

revcomp <- function(s) {
  chars <- strsplit(s, "")[[1]]
  paste(rev(iupac_comp[chars]), collapse = "")
}

iupac_sets <- list(
  A = c("A"), C = c("C"), G = c("G"), T = c("T"),
  R = c("A", "G"), Y = c("C", "T"), S = c("G", "C"), W = c("A", "T"),
  K = c("G", "T"), M = c("A", "C"),
  B = c("C", "G", "T"), D = c("A", "G", "T"), H = c("A", "C", "T"), V = c("A", "C", "G"),
  N = c("A", "C", "G", "T")
)

iupac_compatible <- function(a, b) {
  if (nchar(a) != nchar(b)) return(FALSE)
  ac <- strsplit(a, "")[[1]]
  bc <- strsplit(b, "")[[1]]
  all(mapply(function(x, y) length(intersect(iupac_sets[[x]], iupac_sets[[y]])) > 0, ac, bc))
}
```

```{r}
#| label: cluster-motifs
motifs <- unique(df$Motif)
n_m <- length(motifs)
cluster_id <- setNames(seq_len(n_m), motifs)

merge_clusters <- function(cid, i, j) {
  old <- cid[j]
  new <- cid[i]
  cid[cid == old] <- new
  cid
}

for (i in seq_len(n_m)) {
  for (j in seq_len(n_m)) {
    if (i >= j) next
    m1 <- motifs[i]
    m2 <- motifs[j]
    same <- iupac_compatible(m1, m2) ||
      (nchar(m1) == nchar(m2) && iupac_compatible(m1, revcomp(m2)))
    if (same) cluster_id <- merge_clusters(cluster_id, i, j)
  }
}

motif_family <- tibble(Motif = motifs, family_id = cluster_id[motifs]) %>%
  group_by(family_id) %>%
  mutate(family_label = paste(sort(unique(Motif)), collapse = " / ")) %>%
  ungroup()

df_fam <- df %>% left_join(motif_family, by = "Motif")
```

```{r}
#| label: family-freq
family_isolate_counts <- df_fam %>%
  distinct(sample, family_label) %>%
  count(family_label, name = "n_isolates") %>%
  arrange(desc(n_isolates))

cat("Motif families (IUPAC + reverse-complement aware) by isolate count:\n")
print(family_isolate_counts, n = Inf)
```

```{r}
#| label: family-common
n_isolates_total <- n_isolates

common_families <- family_isolate_counts %>%
  filter(n_isolates == n_isolates_total)

cat("Motif families present in ALL isolates:\n")
print(common_families)
```

```{r}
#| label: load-metadata
metadata <- read.csv("~/Objective_3/Objective_3_motifs_analysis/data/metadata_Apr26.csv")

metadata <- metadata %>% rename(sample = Isolate_ID)
```

```{r}
#| label: join-metadata
df_fam <- df_fam %>%
  left_join(metadata, by = "sample")

# sanity check: any isolates in the motif data with no metadata match?
cat("Isolates missing metadata:\n")
print(setdiff(unique(df_fam$sample), unique(metadata$sample)))
```

```{r}
#| label: sbi-group-sizes
sbi_sizes <- metadata %>%
  count(SBI, name = "n_isolates_in_group") %>%
  arrange(desc(n_isolates_in_group))

cat("Isolates per SBI group:\n")
print(sbi_sizes, n = Inf)
```

```{r}
#| label: sbi-motif-presence
family_sbi_presence <- df_fam %>%
  distinct(sample, family_label, SBI) %>%
  count(family_label, SBI, name = "n_isolates_with_motif") %>%
  left_join(sbi_sizes, by = "SBI") %>%
  mutate(prop_in_group = n_isolates_with_motif / n_isolates_in_group)

cat("Motif family presence by SBI group:\n")
print(family_sbi_presence, n = Inf)
```

```{r}
#| label: sbi-specific-motifs
family_sbi_groups <- family_sbi_presence %>%
  group_by(family_label) %>%
  summarise(
    n_sbi_groups_present = n_distinct(SBI),
    sbi_groups = paste(sort(unique(SBI)), collapse = ", "),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

sbi_specific <- family_sbi_groups %>%
  filter(n_sbi_groups_present == 1)

cat("Motif families found in only ONE SBI group (SBI-specific):\n")
print(sbi_specific, n = Inf)
```

```{r}
#| label: sbi-specific-core
sbi_specific_core <- family_sbi_presence %>%
  semi_join(sbi_specific, by = "family_label") %>%
  filter(prop_in_group == 1)

cat("SBI-specific motifs that are also core (100%) within that group:\n")
print(sbi_specific_core, n = Inf)
```

```{r}
#| label: check-missing
check_family <- function(label) {
  present <- df_fam %>% filter(family_label == label) %>% pull(sample) %>% unique()
  all_samples <- unique(df$sample)
  setdiff(all_samples, present)
}

# Example — replace with a family_label string from the table above:
# check_family("CACNNNNNNNCTGG / CCAGNNNNNNNGTG")
```

```{r}
#| label: sbi-shared-motifs
n_sbi_total <- n_distinct(metadata$SBI)

family_sbi_groups_full <- family_sbi_groups %>%
  arrange(desc(n_sbi_groups_present))

cat("Motif families by number of SBI groups they appear in:\n")
print(family_sbi_groups_full, n = Inf)
```

```{r}
#| label: sbi-shared-motifs-only
# Families present in more than one SBI group (i.e. NOT SBI-specific,
# and not necessarily universal either)
sbi_shared <- family_sbi_groups_full %>%
  filter(n_sbi_groups_present > 1, n_sbi_groups_present < n_sbi_total)

cat("Motif families shared between SOME (but not all) SBI groups:\n")
print(sbi_shared, n = Inf)
```

```{r}
#| label: motif-matrix
# Build isolate x motif-family presence/absence matrix
motif_matrix <- df_fam %>%
  distinct(sample, family_label) %>%
  mutate(present = 1) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = family_label, values_from = present, values_fill = 0)

# Move sample names to rownames, keep only the 0/1 matrix
motif_mat <- as.matrix(motif_matrix %>% select(-sample))
rownames(motif_mat) <- motif_matrix$sample

dim(motif_mat)
```

```{r}
#| label: pcoa-distance
# Jaccard distance is standard for binary presence/absence data
motif_dist <- vegdist(motif_mat, method = "jaccard", binary = TRUE)
```

```{r}
#| label: pcoa-run
pcoa_res <- pcoa(motif_dist)

# Variance explained by each axis
eig_pct <- round(100 * pcoa_res$values$Relative_eig[1:5], 1)
cat("Variance explained by first 5 axes (%):\n")
print(eig_pct)
```

```{r}
#| label: pcoa-plot-data
pcoa_scores <- as.data.frame(pcoa_res$vectors[, 1:2])
colnames(pcoa_scores) <- c("Axis1", "Axis2")
pcoa_scores$sample <- rownames(pcoa_scores)

pcoa_scores <- pcoa_scores %>%
  left_join(metadata, by = "sample")
```

```{r}
#| label: pcoa-plot
ggplot(pcoa_scores, aes(x = Axis1, y = Axis2, color = SBI)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
  labs(
    x = paste0("PCoA1 (", eig_pct[1], "%)"),
    y = paste0("PCoA2 (", eig_pct[2], "%)"),
    title = "PCoA of isolates based on RM motif family presence/absence",
    color = "SBI"
  ) +
  theme_bw()
```

```{r}
#| label: pcoa-plot
ggplot(pcoa_scores, aes(x = Axis1, y = Axis2, color = SBI)) +
  geom_jitter(size = 3, alpha = 0.8, width = 0.01, height = 0.01) +
  labs(
    x = paste0("PCoA1 (", eig_pct[1], "%)"),
    y = paste0("PCoA2 (", eig_pct[2], "%)"),
    title = "PCoA of isolates based on RM motif family presence/absence",
    color = "SBI"
  ) +
  theme_bw()
```

```{r}
#| label: pcoa-plot
ggplot(pcoa_scores, aes(x = Axis1, y = Axis2, color = Stx_gene)) +
  geom_jitter(size = 3, alpha = 0.8, width = 0.01, height = 0.01) +
  labs(
    x = paste0("PCoA1 (", eig_pct[1], "%)"),
```

```{r}
#| label: motifs-per-isolate
# Raw motif count per isolate (exact-string motifs, as reported)
motifs_per_isolate_raw <- df %>%
  distinct(sample, Motif) %>%
  count(sample, name = "n_motifs_raw")

# Family-collapsed motif count per isolate (degenerate/RC variants merged)
motifs_per_isolate_fam <- df_fam %>%
  distinct(sample, family_label) %>%
  count(sample, name = "n_motif_families")

motifs_per_isolate <- motifs_per_isolate_raw %>%
  left_join(motifs_per_isolate_fam, by = "sample") %>%
  left_join(metadata, by = "sample")

cat("Motif counts per isolate:\n")
print(motifs_per_isolate %>% select(sample, SBI, n_motifs_raw, n_motif_families), n = Inf)
```

```{r}
#| label: motifs-per-sbi-summary
sbi_motif_summary <- motifs_per_isolate %>%
  group_by(SBI) %>%
  summarise(
    n_isolates = n(),
    mean_n_motifs_raw = mean(n_motifs_raw),
    sd_n_motifs_raw = sd(n_motifs_raw),
    mean_n_motif_families = mean(n_motif_families),
    sd_n_motif_families = sd(n_motif_families),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(mean_n_motif_families))

cat("Average number of motifs per isolate, by SBI group:\n")
print(sbi_motif_summary, n = Inf)
```

```{r}
#| label: motifs-per-sbi-plot
ggplot(motifs_per_isolate, aes(x = SBI, y = n_motif_families, fill = SBI)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.6, outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, alpha = 0.7, size = 2) +
  labs(
    x = "SBI group",
    y = "Number of motif families per isolate",
    title = "Motif family richness per isolate, by SBI group"
```

```{r}
#| label: avg-isolates-per-motif-per-sbi
# For each SBI group: how many isolates (on average) carry a given motif
# family, considering only motifs actually present in that group
avg_isolates_per_motif_sbi <- family_sbi_presence %>%
  group_by(SBI) %>%
  summarise(
    n_isolates_in_group = first(n_isolates_in_group),
    n_distinct_motifs = n(),
    mean_isolates_per_motif = mean(n_isolates_with_motif),
    sd_isolates_per_motif = sd(n_isolates_with_motif),
    mean_prop_per_motif = mean(prop_in_group),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(mean_prop_per_motif))

cat("Average number (and proportion) of isolates carrying each motif family, by SBI group:\n")
print(avg_isolates_per_motif_sbi, n = Inf)
```

```{r}
#| label: avg-isolates-per-motif-sbi-plot
ggplot(avg_isolates_per_motif_sbi, aes(x = reorder(SBI, mean_prop_per_motif), y = mean_prop_per_motif)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = pmax(0, mean_prop_per_motif - sd_isolates_per_motif / n_isolates_in_group),
                     ymax = pmin(1, mean_prop_per_motif + sd_isolates_per_motif / n_isolates_in_group)),
                width = 0.2) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    x = "SBI group",
    y = "Mean proportion of isolates in group carrying a given motif family",
    title = "Motif conservation within SBI groups"
  ) +
  theme_bw()
```

```{r}
#| label: motif-sbi-presence-absence
motif_sbi_heatmap_data <- family_sbi_presence %>%
  mutate(n_isolates_without_motif = n_isolates_in_group - n_isolates_with_motif) %>%
  select(family_label, SBI, n_isolates_in_group,
         n_isolates_with_motif, n_isolates_without_motif) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(n_isolates_with_motif, n_isolates_without_motif),
    names_to = "status",
    values_to = "n_isolates"
  ) %>%
  mutate(status = recode(status,
                          n_isolates_with_motif = "Present",
                          n_isolates_without_motif = "Absent"))

cat("Motif presence/absence counts by SBI group:\n")
print(motif_sbi_heatmap_data, n = Inf)
```

```{r}
#| label: motif-sbi-heatmap-plot
ggplot(motif_sbi_heatmap_data, aes(x = SBI, y = family_label, fill = n_isolates)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = n_isolates), size = 2.8) +
  facet_wrap(~status) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "steelblue") +
  labs(
    x = "SBI group",
    y = "Motif family",
    fill = "Isolates",
    title = "Isolates with vs without each motif family, by SBI group"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7))
```

```{r}
#| label: short-family-labels
motif_family <- motif_family %>%
  group_by(family_id) %>%
  mutate(
    family_short = paste0(min(Motif), " (+", n() - 1, " variants)"),
    family_full = paste(sort(unique(Motif)), collapse = " / ")
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# check how big the clusters actually are
family_family_sizes <- motif_family %>%
  distinct(family_id, family_short, family_full) %>%
  mutate(n_variants = str_count(family_full, "/") + 1) %>%
  arrange(desc(n_variants))

cat("Largest motif family clusters:\n")
print(family_family_sizes %>% select(family_short, n_variants), n = 15)
```

```{r}
#| label: propagate-short-labels
df_fam <- df %>%
  left_join(motif_family %>% select(Motif, family_id, family_short, family_full),
            by = "Motif")
```

```{r}
#| label: rebuild-family-sbi-presence
family_sbi_presence <- df_fam %>%
  left_join(metadata, by = "sample") %>%
  distinct(sample, family_short, SBI) %>%
  count(family_short, SBI, name = "n_isolates_with_motif") %>%
  left_join(sbi_sizes, by = "SBI") %>%
  mutate(prop_in_group = n_isolates_with_motif / n_isolates_in_group)
```

```{r}
#| label: motif-sbi-presence-absence-v2
motif_sbi_heatmap_data <- family_sbi_presence %>%
  mutate(n_isolates_without_motif = n_isolates_in_group - n_isolates_with_motif) %>%
  select(family_short, SBI, n_isolates_in_group,
         n_isolates_with_motif, n_isolates_without_motif) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(n_isolates_with_motif, n_isolates_without_motif),
    names_to = "status",
    values_to = "n_isolates"
  ) %>%
  mutate(status = recode(status,
                          n_isolates_with_motif = "Present",
                          n_isolates_without_motif = "Absent"))
```

```{r}
#| label: motif-sbi-heatmap-save-v2
p <- ggplot(motif_sbi_heatmap_data, aes(x = SBI, y = family_short, fill = n_isolates)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = n_isolates), size = 2.8) +
  facet_wrap(~status) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "steelblue") +
  labs(
    x = "SBI group",
    y = "Motif family",
    fill = "Isolates",
    title = "Isolates with vs without each motif family, by SBI group"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7))

ggsave("motif_sbi_heatmap.png", plot = p, width = 12, height = 14, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
#| label: motif-sbi-heatmap-refine
# Drop the two universal motifs (all-present, zero variability, uninformative here)
uninformative <- c("GATC (+0 variants)", "CCTGG (+1 variants)")

# Order rows by how variable presence is across SBI groups —
# most differentiating motifs at the top
row_order <- family_sbi_presence %>%
  filter(!family_short %in% uninformative) %>%
  group_by(family_short) %>%
  summarise(variability = sd(prop_in_group), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(variability)) %>%
  pull(family_short)

motif_sbi_heatmap_data_refined <- motif_sbi_heatmap_data %>%
  filter(!family_short %in% uninformative) %>%
  mutate(family_short = factor(family_short, levels = rev(row_order)))
```

```{r}
#| label: motif-sbi-heatmap-save-refined
p <- ggplot(motif_sbi_heatmap_data_refined, aes(x = SBI, y = family_short, fill = n_isolates)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = n_isolates), size = 2.8) +
  facet_wrap(~status) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "steelblue") +
  labs(
    x = "SBI group",
    y = "Motif family",
    fill = "Isolates",
    title = "Isolates with vs without each motif family, by SBI group",
    subtitle = "Rows ordered by variability in presence across SBI groups (most differentiating at top)"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7))

ggsave("motif_sbi_heatmap_refined.png", plot = p, width = 12, height = 13, dpi = 300)
```
